description: KV-cache index, KV-events subscriber and tokenization health for the llm-d precise prefix-cache pipeline.

options.content:
# KV-Cache Index

Operational view of the precise prefix-cache pipeline embedded in the EPP: the KV-block index, the KV-events subscribers that feed it, and the tokenization step in front of it. The `llm_d_epp_kv_cache_index_*` panels stay at zero unless the `precise-prefix-cache-producer` sets `indexerConfig.kvBlockIndexConfig.enableMetrics: true`. Metric definitions: [pkg/kvcache/metrics](https://github.com/llm-d/llm-d-router/tree/main/pkg/kvcache/metrics).

panels.title: Predicted Hit Rate
panels.description: Share of prompt tokens the precise producer predicted the chosen endpoint already holds, over the dashboard's time range.

panels.title: Index Lookups / s
panels.description: Rate of KV-block index Lookup calls.

panels.title: Admissions / s
panels.description: KV blocks written to the index per second.

panels.title: Evictions / s
panels.description: KV blocks removed from the index per second.

panels.title: Lookup P99
panels.description: P99 index lookup latency. Lookups run on the request path.

panels.title: Active Subscribers
panels.description: ZMQ subscribers the EPP manages, one per model server pod. Includes subscribers retrying a failed connection.

panels.title: Admissions vs Evictions
panels.description: Block admissions and evictions per second. Net growth is admissions minus evictions; a sustained negative value means the index is shrinking (for example after model server restarts or cache resets).

panels.title: Lookup Rate by EPP Replica
panels.description: Index Lookup calls per second, per EPP pod.

panels.title: Predicted Prefix Hit Rate
panels.description: Share of prompt tokens the precise producer predicted the chosen endpoint holds in its prefix cache. Workloads without shared prefixes legitimately sit near zero.

targets.expr: sum by (plugin_name) (rate(llm_d_epp_prefix_predicted_cached_tokens_sum{namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", plugin_type="precise-prefix-cache-producer"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (plugin_name) (rate(llm_d_epp_prefix_prompt_tokens_sum{namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", plugin_type="precise-prefix-cache-producer"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Matched Prefix Blocks per Lookup
panels.description: Average length of the longest contiguous prefix chain a single pod holds, per lookup. This counts blocks, so it is not a 0-1 hit rate.

panels.title: Prompt vs Predicted-Cached Tokens
panels.description: Prompt tokens per second scored by the precise producer, and the portion predicted to be served from the chosen endpoint's prefix cache.

panels.title: Index Lookup Latency
panels.description: Duration of index Lookup and WalkKeys calls, including WalkKeys callbacks. The histogram uses Prometheus default buckets, whose lowest bound is 5ms, so sub-5ms lookups are interpolated within that bucket.

panels.title: Tokenization Latency (token-producer)
panels.description: Time the token-producer plugin spends tokenizing each prompt through the render service. llm_d_epp_plugin_duration_seconds has a top bucket of 100ms, so quantiles cap there; see the next panel for the share of calls above it.

panels.title: Tokenizations Slower than 100ms
panels.description: Share of token-producer calls that took longer than the 100ms top histogram bucket.

panels.title: Precise Producer Time by Extension Point
panels.description: P99 time the precise-prefix-cache-producer spends in each extension point (scoring-path lookup, speculative indexing on PreRequest).

panels.title: Messages Received by Pod
panels.description: KV-event messages received per second from each model server pod.

panels.title: Subscriber Reconnections
panels.description: Reconnection attempts per second. A sustained rate means the EPP keeps losing that pod's event stream.

panels.title: ZMQ Errors
panels.description: ZMQ subscriber errors per second by pod and failed operation (bind, connect, subscribe, recv, replay-*).

panels.title: Event Pool Backlog
panels.description: Messages queued across all event-pool worker shards, and the number of shards. A sustained backlog means the index lags behind the model servers; raise kvEventsConfig.concurrency.

panels.title: Removal Dedup
panels.description: Block hashes whose removal the dedup filter suppressed (still referenced elsewhere) vs forwarded to the index as evictions.

panels.title: Skipped Events
panels.description: Store and removal events skipped before prefix indexing, by cache kind and reason.

panels.title: Scrape Up
panels.description: Whether Prometheus can scrape each EPP replica hosting the index.

targets.expr: max by (pod) (up{namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod"} and on (namespace, pod) llm_d_epp_kv_cache_events_pool_capacity{namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod"})

panels.title: EPP Resident Memory
panels.description: Resident memory of each EPP replica. With the in-memory index backend, index size shows up here.

targets.expr: max by (pod) (process_resident_memory_bytes{namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod"} and on (namespace, pod) llm_d_epp_kv_cache_events_pool_capacity{namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod"})

panels.title: EPP Goroutines
panels.description: Goroutines per EPP replica. Each KV-events subscriber runs its own goroutine, so this tracks subscriber count plus request load.

targets.expr: max by (pod) (go_goroutines{namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod"} and on (namespace, pod) llm_d_epp_kv_cache_events_pool_capacity{namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod"})

panels.title: EPP Restarts
panels.description: Container restarts of EPP replicas over the last hour (requires kube-state-metrics). A restart empties the in-memory index.

targets.expr: sum by (pod) (increase(kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total{namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[1h]) and on (namespace, pod) llm_d_epp_kv_cache_events_pool_capacity{namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod"})
